input.summary: The owner has resolved delay placement (one-way, sender-to-receiver, 0 ms vs 20 ms). Several workload and bottleneck parameters remain unresolved before a full pilot proposal can be written.
clarification_questions: What is the bottleneck bandwidth (in Mbit/s) and queue size (in packets or bytes) to emulate at the bottleneck link?
What is the transfer size or workload per flow (e.g., number of bytes or a fixed file size) and how many concurrent flows, if any, should be run per replication?
How many replications per condition do you want, and are there any wall-clock or cost constraints on the pilot (e.g., maximum total wall seconds or budget)?
